text:
Ilse Marrenkamp was appointed chief executive of Varnholt Logistics in March, the company said on Thursday. The regional freight and warehousing firm, based in Loden Quay, confirmed that Marrenkamp, 52, took over after a six-month interim period following the retirement of founder-chief executive Tomas Veer. She will oversee a planned expansion of the company’s cold-storage capacity and a new rail-linked distribution yard outside Brinwater.

Marrenkamp previously served as operations director at Northmere Shipping, where she managed a workforce of about 1,100. “Her track record in supply-chain management makes her a strong fit for Varnholt’s next phase,” said Harbour Council economic development chief Nina Felder. Varnholt said it expects to add 40 jobs by the end of the year.
